pcs.pc_description: Collect data about the products and services used in the day-to-day operations of the company from internal and external stakeholders.
Check whether the existing practices comply with applicable environmental, waste management and disposal regulations.
Collect info on the recyclable, non-recyclable, non-biodegradable and hazardous waste products in daily operations.
Gather information about the usage of different materials, natural resources including water, the pattern of electricity and fuel consumption.
Collect information about materials that environmentally friendly substitutes can replace.
Detect the business processes where sustainability could be integrated e.g. Returns Management, shipping etc.
Differentiate the indicators of conventional management practices that lead to unutilised or waste of resources.
Collect data on existing inventory control management.
Explore the subsidies and benefits offered by the government and different organisations for investments in sustainability/ greening factors. E.g. setting up solar energy plants.
Evaluate information obtained from other departments and stakeholders.
Perform materiality analysis of the products/ services acquired and used frequently.
Analyse material audit reports to identify excessive consumption of material and water.
Calculate the carbon footprint/emissions from the source of the products.
Identify processes where material utilisation can be optimised.
Conduct a cost-benefit analysis based on the factors that will undergo a change in the process of sustainability implementation.
Discuss with Management the budget for the journey towards Sustainability and build a list of social innovation solutions.
Communicate with industries and customers to understand and analyse various strategies, demands, and limitations in the market.
Analyse energy/electricity consumption data and identify high energy/electricity consumption areas.
Categorise processes where energy/electricity utilisation can be optimised and recommend the potential of using renewable energy.
Identify the non-recyclable/non-degradable raw materials used in manufacturing the product/service.
Measure the emissions/carbon footprints currently generated by the company using ISO- approved methods.
Monitor material and water conservation processes for any process gaps.
Perform risk management analysis based on factors that might be affected during the transition, like client expectations & requirements, stakeholder interests, and efficient usage of resources.
Check the possibilities of implementing sustainability on the entire product life cycle involving design, production, distribution, consumer use, post-use recovery, and reuse.

Analyse the inventory control and procurement methods currently followed and the scope of reducing the same. The results may be shorter lead times, reduced transportation costs, improved overall operational efficiency and significant sustainability.

pcs.pc_description: Create a flowchart with the sustainable practices to be implemented.
Propose digitisation of monitoring, reporting and measurement processes from the ground.
Recommend digital platforms wherever possible for validation of the reports.
Create a ground plan to reduce/negate emissions/carbon footprints currently generated by the company.
List sustainable business practices that can be listed on sustainability indices.
Construct a plan/ SOP for collecting, segregating and disposing of recyclable, non-recyclable and hazardous waste.
Compare the sustainability practices followed by Industry peers for benchmarking & calibration.
Propose methods of lean manufacturing.
Suggest management to support stakeholders/ vendors who follow sustainable practices.
Perform cost-benefit analysis for the new investments containing factors like long-term benefits, capex, opex expenditures etc.

Develop processes to maintain and have zero wastage/ emission or net-positive water footprint by implementing ways to conserve and reuse water. E.g., installing automated/sensor-enabled water faucets, installing low-flow faucets and toilets, fixing leaks promptly, optimising water-intensive processes, installing sewage water treatment plants, rainwater harvesting etc.
Build various solutions to recycle/reuse/reduce the non-recyclable/non-degradable materials.

Analyse the essential ingredients/ practices that make a facility highly energy efficient. E.g., switching off electrical equipment and appliances when not in use, using LED lights with sensors, changing over to intelligent appliances, etc.
Use a combination of direct, indirect, industrywide, and global strategies.
Propose management to invest and set up alternate/ renewable energy sources like solar, wind, etc.
Ensure that the activities/ processes are within the budget allotted.
Decide on indicators to report on and choose the relevant stakeholders.
Map the changes that the company would undergo and get approval from management before implementation.
Devise sustainability practices, right from decisions involving designing, strategy, tactics, goals, processes, trade-offs and outcomes in all levels of supply chain management.
Develop an energy management system containing scheduled shutdowns, regular maintenance and optimisation of air compressors, HVAC, lighting system, etc.
Ensure that an SOP is created for all the set processes.
Conduct awareness programs among staff and stakeholders explaining the expected results and how these sustainability practices create an impact.

pcs.pc_description: Implement the usage of vehicles that run on alternate fuels.
Give preference to vendors who provide eco- friendly road transport options like EV, LNG, CNG, GH2 etc.
Coordinate with stakeholders in choosing a sustainable transit option using multimodal transport and its impact on factors like transit time.
Plan for effective space utilisation by exploring options like consolidated shipping, maximizing loading efficiency, etc.
Build transportation networks using rail and inland waterways for the long haul due to their lower GNG emissions.
Minimise waste space and energy by ensuring the containers and transport are packed to maximum capacity.
Use an effective transport management system for route planning, integrated with trip management, forecasting and demand planning.
Recommend ethical sourcing and procuring materials, parts locally in order to reduce transportation costs and carbon emissions.
Propose adapting to new technologies and tools like scanners, sensors etc. which help save resources, e.g. enable paperless transactions, auto cut off.
Ensure that the fuel efficiency practices are followed by the drivers and end users.
Suggest re-designing of transport packaging and containers for modularity and optimal fit.
Explore alternative solutions like logistics pooling, which are sustainable in the longer run e.g. asset sharing and open warehouses.
Analyse and optimise last mile deliveries with customer coordination.

pcs.pc_description: Calculate the packing waste created during the entire process from loading to delivery to the seller/end user.
Suggest management for designing/customising sustainable packing.
According to the product, select suitable sustainable packing materials, e.g. paper honeycomb core, paper tapes, corrugated boards, etc.
Choose the layers/ fillers that are biodegradable or recyclable, e.g. mycelium fillers.
Avoid using SUP (Single-Use Plastics), e.g., shrink wraps.
Prevent overuse of packing materials (over wrapping/re-wrapping of pallets); this will increase waste & carbon footprint.
Follow the disposing/ recycling instructions printed on the cartons.
Avoid space and voids to a maximum by using the right size of tertiary packing.
Use machinery and equipment like MHE that runs on electric or alternative clean energy.
Implement storage systems that are compact and automated.
Enhance the current warehouse design and layout according to the processes for optimal utilisation and for reducing material handling distances.
Use sustainable climate control options for temperature maintenance, e.g. hydronic heating, ice-powered air conditioners, sensor-controlled ventilation systems, etc.
Implement RRR - Reduce, Reuse, Recycle.
Ensure the proper mechanism is followed to treat wastewater in the unit.
Propose building upward extension instead of outward to reduce land use.
Choose energy-efficient lighting and recommend installing Skylights, LEDs with sensors (Intelligent occupancy sensors, Motion sensors, Heat Maps), etc.
Propose a warehouse location considering factors like being close to hubs and availability of public transportation etc.
Ensure that Lighting Power Density (LPD) does not exceed the required.
Recommend replacing smart appliances instead of traditional high power consuming standard devices, e.g., HVAC and refrigeration systems.
Use efficient software and handheld devices to assign tasks instead of printing, e.g., using WMS to generate and set pick lists.
Opt for devices and PPE which can be sanitised and reused.
Ensure health & safety and material handling procedures are properly followed.

pcs.pc_description: Follow the steps as per the roadmap developed for the business transition by measuring and monitoring according to indicators.
Assign the tasks to respective stakeholders and determine the success indicators for the transition.
Implement the introduction of revised processes and environment-friendly materials in a phased manner.
Ensure a proper mechanism is followed while collecting, segregating and disposing of recyclable, non-recyclable and hazardous waste as per SOP.
Implement the principle of Reduce, Reuse and Recycle (RRR) and align with the circular economy.
Initiate planting trees around company premises and install indoor plants wherever feasible.
Observe the gaps in transition and implement the learnings to take corrective actions.
Ensure training and assist in implementing sustainable practices among staff and stakeholders.
Let first-tier suppliers set long-term sustainability goals and include lower-tier suppliers in the overall sustainability strategy.
Task a staff point person to extend the firm's sustainability program to first, lower-tier suppliers and to ensure compliance with SOP.
Find measurement tools for sustainable business and measure the impact.
Use the guidelines and standards in India and Internationally, e.g. ISO2600, BRSR.
Chart the alignment with the sustainability indices and identify project success indicators.
Devise a measurement matrix for the success and failure of the indicators.
Develop risk factors for the specific CSR/ Sustainability project's success and failure for the business.
List different CSR & sustainability reporting methodologies available in India and Internationally.
Implement a reporting format accepted globally and per the company's requirements, e.g. GRI standards.
Map the changes undergone by the company and evaluate the emission of pollutants.
Build a monitoring system for calculating the impact of each sustainability factor and practice.
